psychosexual-therapy.body:
Sexual difficulties are common, and they are treatable. Most people who come to me have been carrying something for a long time before they say it out loud, and the saying it out loud is usually the hardest part of the whole process. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

This page goes into more detail than the front page does. If you would rather just ask, that is fine too — **you do not need the right words to make the first call**. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

## What people bring

There is no list that covers everyone, but these come up often. Any of them is a reasonable reason to get in touch, and so is something that is not here. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

- Pain during sex, or fear of pain
- Erections that are unreliable, or that come and go
- Ejaculation that is too fast, too slow, or absent
- Difficulty reaching orgasm, or reaching it differently than you used to
- Desire that has dropped away, or that never matched a partner's
- Worry about pornography, or about a habit that has stopped feeling like a choice
- Sex after illness, surgery, childbirth or menopause *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

## How the work goes

### The first session

The first session is mostly listening. I will ask what brought you, what you have already tried, and what you would like to be different — and you can answer as much or as little of that as you want to. Nothing is examined and nothing is demonstrated. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

By the end of it we will usually have a rough sense of whether this is the right sort of help, and whether I am the right person. If I am not, I will say so and try to point you somewhere better. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

### After that

Sessions are weekly to begin with. How long the work runs depends on what we find, but a rough shape is: *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

1. Two or three sessions working out what is actually going on, which is often not what it looked like from the outside
2. A stretch of the work itself, which may include things to try between sessions
3. A review, where we decide together whether to continue, pause or finish *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

> Nobody has ever come in and told me something I had not heard before. Whatever it is, it is not the worst thing I have been told this month. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

## Working with couples

Some of this work is better done with a partner in the room and some is better done alone, and it is quite normal to move between the two. If you are not sure which you want, come on your own first and we will work it out. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*

I see couples, and I also see people whose partner does not know they are here. Neither is unusual, and neither is a problem. Details of what I charge are on the [fees section of the home page](/#fees), and you can [write to me]({mailto}) if you would rather ask before you ring. *(MOCKONLY-8f3a1c)*
